choices.text: A router configured only with wired interfaces
choices.explanation: That does not supply the required radio interface.

choices.text: An access point using the intended bridged WLAN/VLAN mapping
choices.explanation: The AP provides wireless attachment while another device retains the routing role.

choices.text: A Layer 2 switch with no wireless radio
choices.explanation: It can switch Ethernet but cannot directly serve 802.11 clients.

questions.explanation: Identify both the required radio function and the specified forwarding model. An AP need not also be the clients’ IP router.

questions.prompt: A legacy 100 Mb/s link has both ends forced full duplex. Its late-collision counter is zero, but a cable movement causes carrier flaps. Which next action is best aligned with the evidence?

choices.text: Assume the lack of collisions proves the cable is good
choices.explanation: A cable can lose carrier without generating collisions.

choices.text: Inspect and test the affected cable, connector, and port path
choices.explanation: Movement-correlated carrier loss points toward physical connectivity.

choices.text: Change both ends to half duplex to remove all physical faults
choices.explanation: Duplex changes do not repair intermittent contact.

choices.text: Increase the DNS cache size
choices.explanation: Resolver caching does not stabilize electrical carrier.

questions.explanation: Use the observed failure mechanism to choose the next check. Zero collisions does not rule out an intermittent physical link.

questions.prompt: A sender reports that TCP acknowledged all bytes containing a database update. Which conclusion is justified by that acknowledgment alone?

choices.text: The database transaction is committed to durable storage
choices.explanation: TCP receipt is not an application commit acknowledgment.

choices.explanation: The evidence is at the transport layer.

choices.text: The operation can never be rolled back
choices.explanation: Application state and rollback behavior are outside TCP’s guarantee.

questions.explanation: Transport success and application completion are different events. The application protocol must provide the evidence needed for database commit.

questions.prompt: A host is configured as 10.60.10.200/24, but its VLAN is assigned 10.60.10.192/27. Its router is 10.60.10.193/27. Which correction aligns the host’s local-subnet decision with the intended VLAN?

choices.text: Keep /24 because the first three octets match the router
choices.explanation: Matching visible octets does not make different prefix boundaries equivalent.

choices.text: Change the router to 10.60.10.223/27

questions.prompt: Which TWO assertions about IPv6 addressing are correct? Select two.

choices.text: IPv6 uses 255.255.255.255 for all-nodes broadcast
choices.explanation: That is IPv4 notation, and IPv6 has no broadcast type.

choices.text: The address ::1 identifies every router on the link
choices.explanation: ::1 is the local loopback address.

choices.text: IPv6 uses multicast for functions that might otherwise require broadcast-style group delivery
choices.explanation: Multicast supplies IPv6 group addressing without a broadcast address type.

choices.text: A link-local unicast destination must not be forwarded onto another link
choices.explanation: Its scope is restricted to the link.

choices.text: Every global-unicast address must be generated from a MAC
choices.explanation: IPv6 permits other identifier-generation methods.

questions.explanation: IPv6 distinguishes individual, group, loopback, and scoped uses. Similar operational goals do not imply identical IPv4 and IPv6 address mechanisms.

questions.prompt: The table below contains a fresh destination entry for B in VLAN 60. A frame from A to B enters Gi1/0/2 in VLAN 60. All relevant ports are forwarding. Which action is correct?

exhibit.content:
VLAN   MAC address       Type      Port
60     00bb.0000.0060     DYNAMIC   Gi1/0/7

Received frame:
source A = 00aa.0000.0060
destination B = 00bb.0000.0060

choices.text: Send only to Gi1/0/2 because it is the source port
choices.explanation: The destination entry points to a different port.

choices.text: Flood VLAN 60 because A is not yet in the table
choices.explanation: An unknown source does not make the known destination unknown.

choices.text: Learn A on Gi1/0/2 and forward toward B on Gi1/0/7
choices.explanation: Source learning and known-destination forwarding can occur together.

choices.text: Learn B on Gi1/0/2 and forward to VLAN 70
choices.explanation: Learning uses the source and forwarding remains in VLAN 60.

questions.explanation: Consult the destination mapping independently of whether the source is new. A fresh source can be learned during a directed unicast forwarding operation.

questions.prompt: An administrator intends to derive an IPv6 identifier from MAC 00-25-96-12-34-56 using modified EUI-64. The proposed result is 0025:96ff:fe12:3456. Which correction is needed?

choices.explanation: The middle insertion is required by the specified procedure.

choices.text: Change the first hextet from 0025 to 0225
choices.explanation: The U/L bit in the first byte has not yet been inverted.

interface Vlan1
